warnings.message: Missing additional dynamic DMA metadata, reported DMA values may be inaccurate. To enable more accurate DMA data, re-capture with --enable-dge-notifs flag or set NEURON_RT_ENABLE_DGE_NOTIFICATIONS=1 before running. Note: DGE notifications are disabled by default as they can cause execution timeouts on some models.
Notification from block DMA of type DMA were dropped. This can cause corresponding data to be incorrect.
Current NEFF is missing compiler metrics. Please re-compile using latest version of the compiler

Missing HLO stats in the NEFF, `model_flops` and `mfu_hlo_estimated_percent` summary metrics will not be available. Consider the metrics (hardware_flops - transpose_flops) and mfu_inst_estimated_percent instead.

Schema validation: Unexpected key 'subgraph' cannot be saved to table 'TimelineAnnotation' because no schema.yaml entry exists or no key name remapping. This key and value will be dropped and not found in parquet output.

caveats: Profiled execution is for attribution; use unprofiled phase timing for throughput.
Active fractions are independently derived for each physical core and graph.
Instruction-duration sums overlap and cannot be treated as operation wall times.
Missing DMA notifications and dropped packets preclude an exact HBM bound.
HLO/kernel attribution requires nonempty source fields; no names are inferred from DMA counts.
